run_scannet_reader_export_depth: run the scannet reader to export depth images from a sens file to an output folder
run_scannet_reader_export_color: run the scannet reader to export color images from a sens file to an output folder
run_scannet_reader_export_poses: run the scannet reader to export camera poses from a sens file to an output folder
run_scannet_reader_export_intrinsics: run the scannet reader to export camera intrinsics from a sens file to an output folder
run_scannet_reader_with_frame_skip: run the scannet reader with a frame skip value to subsample exported frames from a sens file
